---
title: "Tribunal Calendar"
description: "Per (tribunal, date) archival status — uploaded or confirmed-absent."
output: /data/tribunal_calendar.json
format: array
---

Status dia-a-dia por tribunal, usado pelo calendário/heatmap de
`/publicacoes/[tribunal]` e pela exportação CSV de cobertura. Restrito a
`uploaded`/`absent` — dias `pending`/`unknown` não têm estado a exibir no
calendário e só inflariam o payload.

```{sql}
SELECT
  tribunal,
  date,
  CASE
    WHEN ia_status = 'uploaded' THEN 'uploaded'
    WHEN djen_status = 'absent' THEN 'absent'
  END AS status
FROM manifest
WHERE ia_status = 'uploaded' OR djen_status = 'absent'
ORDER BY tribunal, date;
```
